description: Overlay 3 of 6 in the S3 Spine sequence. Evaluates integration quality across the components, regimes, and signals of a Triadic system via the Coherence Index (CI) tensor. Gates the Triadic Regime Synthesizer — synthesis is only valid when CI ≥ 0.55. Detects fragmentation zones before structural faultlines fully activate. Coordinates with the Cross-Domain Causality Weaver to trace coherence loss across domain boundaries.
role: Integration quality assessor and synthesis gatekeeper — scores CI tensor and gates Triadic Regime Synthesizer at CI ≥ 0.55
purpose: Overlay 3/6: evaluates integration quality via CI tensor; synthesis gate (CI ≥ 0.55); detects fragmentation zones; traces cross-boundary coherence loss with Cross-Domain Causality Weaver
exports: Cross-domain coherence loss trace (to Substrate Overlay)
